discussion.body: Act 12. Rails resume. Open world locks the instant the party uses the Deep key. Path: airship to the Cannon wreck, descent through the loading city as a ruin, Fissure mouth as a war grave, then the threshold of the Deep. Mid-confrontations only: Vortan and/or Velith if they still have a body and were not finished in Act 10. No Nyxara last fight. No side boards except what you already finished. Party composition is whoever still lives plus the two mains.
